entry.title: New: BILL030(24) (Honolulu) — FILE
entry.content:
RELATING TO REAL PROPERTY TAXATION.

Establishes a real property tax exemption for land owned and leased by the State of Hawai’i. Provides application requirements for the exemption. Applies to tax years beginning July 1, 2026 and thereafter.

Latest action: Filed pursuant to ROH SEC 1-2.4 which sets a two-year filing period on pending bills.
